package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"math"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseMoreDiscovery(t *testing.T) {
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-more-discovery"
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bits := []uint64{0, 1, 0x8000000000000000, 0x8000000000000001, 0x7fefffffffffffff, 0xffefffffffffffff}
	for _, f := range []float64{1, -1, 1e-4, 1e-5, 1e5, 1e6, 1e20, 1e21, 1.2345678901234567, math.SmallestNonzeroFloat64, math.MaxFloat64} {
		bits = append(bits, math.Float64bits(f))
	}
	seed := uint64(0xcafebabedeadbeef)
	for len(bits) < 273 {
		seed ^= seed << 13
		seed ^= seed >> 7
		seed ^= seed << 17
		if seed>>52&2047 != 2047 {
			bits = append(bits, seed)
		}
	}
	type Float struct {
		Bits string `json:"bits"`
		Text string `json:"text"`
	}
	floats := []Float{}
	all := &tempopb.Trace{}
	var rows []*Trace
	for i, b := range bits {
		f := math.Float64frombits(b)
		floats = append(floats, Float{fmt.Sprintf("%016x", b), traceql.NewStaticFloat(f).EncodeToString(false)})
		r := batch(1, []string{"worker", "frontend"}[i%2], []string{"", "operation", "operation\n😀"}[i%3], 1, 0, uint64(10+i), uint64(11+i))
		s := r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0]
		binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(s.TraceId[8:], uint64(i+1))
		attr := func() *cv.KeyValue {
			return &cv.KeyValue{Key: "value", Value: &cv.AnyValue{Value: &cv.AnyValue_DoubleValue{DoubleValue: f}}}
		}
		r.Resource.Attributes = append(r.Resource.Attributes, attr())
		s.Attributes = []*cv.KeyValue{attr(), value("shared", "span")}
		r.Resource.Attributes = append(r.Resource.Attributes, value("shared", "resource"))
		r.ScopeSpans[0].Scope = &cv.InstrumentationScope{Name: []string{"", "sdk"}[i%2], Version: []string{"", "v1", "v2"}[i%3], Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{attr(), value("shared", "instrumentation")}}
		if i%4 != 0 {
			s.Status = &tv.Status{Message: []string{"", "detail", "detail\n😀"}[i%3]}
		}
		if i%3 != 0 {
			s.Events = []*tv.Span_Event{{TimeUnixNano: s.StartTimeUnixNano, Name: "", Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{attr(), value("shared", "event")}}, {TimeUnixNano: s.StartTimeUnixNano, Name: "event\n😀", Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{attr()}}}
			s.Links = []*tv.Span_Link{{TraceId: s.TraceId, SpanId: s.SpanId, Attributes: []*cv.KeyValue{attr(), value("shared", "link")}}}
		}
		if i == 0 {
			r.ScopeSpans[0].Scope = nil
		}
		all.ResourceSpans = append(all.ResourceSpans, r)
		row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, s.TraceId, &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}}, nil)
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(all)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/input.protobuf", wire, 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
	opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
	engine := traceql.NewEngine()
	type Case struct {
		Target   string `json:"target"`
		Query    string `json:"query"`
		Response any    `json:"response"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	targets := []string{"resource.value", "span.value", "instrumentation.value", "event.value", "link.value", ".value", ".shared", ".absent", "name", "span:name", "statusMessage", "span:statusMessage", "instrumentation:name", "instrumentation:version", "event:name"}
	for _, name := range targets {
		queries := []string{""}
		if name[0] != '.' && (name == "resource.value" || name == "span.value" || name == "instrumentation.value" || name == "event.value" || name == "link.value") {
			queries = append(queries, `{resource.service.name="worker"}`)
		}
		for _, q := range queries {
			tag, err := traceql.ParseIdentifier(name)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			set := map[tempopb.TagValue]bool{}
			collect := traceql.MakeCollectTagValueFunc(func(v tempopb.TagValue) bool { set[v] = true; return false })
			if q == "" {
				err = block.SearchTagValuesV2(context.Background(), tag, collect, func(uint64) {}, opts)
			} else {
				fetch := traceql.NewTagValuesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchTagValuesRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagValuesCallback) error {
					return block.FetchTagValues(ctx, r, cb, func(uint64) {}, opts)
				})
				err = engine.ExecuteTagValues(context.Background(), tag, q, collect, fetch)
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			vals := []*tempopb.TagValue{}
			for v := range set {
				v := v
				vals = append(vals, &v)
			}
			sort.Slice(vals, func(i, j int) bool {
				if vals[i].Type == vals[j].Type {
					return vals[i].Value < vals[j].Value
				}
				return vals[i].Type < vals[j].Type
			})
			cases = append(cases, Case{name, q, map[string]any{"tagValues": vals}})
			if wire, e := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf(dir+"/result-%02d.protobuf", len(cases)-1)); e == nil {
				got := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{}
				if e = proto.Unmarshal(wire, got); e != nil {
					t.Fatal(e)
				}
				want := &tempopb.SearchTagValuesV2Response{TagValues: vals}
				if !proto.Equal(got, want) {
					t.Fatalf("consumer %s %s", name, q)
				}
			} else if !os.IsNotExist(e) {
				t.Fatal(e)
			}
		}
	}
	for file, data := range map[string]any{"floats.json": floats, "oracle.json": cases} {
		raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(data, "", "  ")
		if err = os.WriteFile(dir+"/"+file, append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}
